scenes.visual: A clean, minimalist white environment featuring three animated flat-style paper icons arranged horizontally. The background is a solid off-white gradient with subtle lighting from the top-center. Each icon is white with thin gray borders, mimicking file documents. The first icon on the left is labeled 'README.md', the middle 'LICENSE', and the third '.gitignore'. Above the labels, placeholder text representing code or documentation is visible on each paper. The lighting is diffused and professional, casting soft shadows beneath the icons.

The first card (README.md) flips to black with purple and white text appearing. Then the second card (LICENSE) flips to black with purple and white text. Finally, the third card (.gitignore) flips to black with yellow and white text. The cards have rounded corners and remain in the same horizontal alignment. The lighting remains static and even across the frame.
